description: Make a film public on its film page. Refused, with the same message the film editor shows, while the publish checklist is incomplete: title, poster, a ready main film, and a price only when it is Buy or rent (a free-to-watch film publishes without one). The checklist comes back with how to finish each open item: update_film or start_film_upload where a tool can do it, and the editor link for the poster, which is added in the film editor, not through this connection.

film_id.description: The film's public id (from list_films / get_film).
